gloss_en: The altar (mizbe'ach) of the Temple as expounded in Likutey Moharan I:17 — the aspect of holy eating, identified with a person's table that atones like the altar (Berakhot 55a) and with 'the altar in the portion of the one who snatches' (Binyamin); its completion subdues the foolishness of the intellect, whose kelipot draw their sustenance from eating
